disposition_reason: Reports location means ± SD of Pb, Cd, Hg and As (mg/kg) in 24 bee-honey samples (3 per locality) from eight western Libya localities.
disposition_locator: Table 2 (Minerals composition of honey samples), p.619

study.material_scope: bee honey; floral types not identified (authors attribute variation to floral type without stating them)
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Collected from eight locations in west Libya (GR, BL, MS, RH, AB, AD, TC, TE); whether from apiaries or markets is not stated.
study.collection_period: Spring ('Station: Spring' in Table 1 caption); year not reported
study.sampling_unit: honey samples (3 per locality; results reported as locality means)
study.method: 1.0 g honey + 6 mL 65% HNO3 + 2 mL H2O2 (30 vol), Milestone microwave digestion, made to 25 mL; AAS (Shimadzu AA-6701F, hollow cathode lamp) per AOAC
study.basis: Not stated; assumed as-is honey weight (mg/kg).
study.qa: Calibration standards 0.1-2.5 ppm diluted from 1000 ppm stock; no CRM, recovery or blanks reported.

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Summary says values are on a 'honey-as-sold basis'; the primary does not state basis or whether samples were retail or apiary.
Summary does not flag that the Table 2 footnote claims '(minimum - maximum); mean ±SD' while only mean ± SD is printed.
Summary does not flag SD >= mean for Hg (BL, MS, TC, TE) and As (MS, TC, TE), nor the very high Pb means (2.42-10.98 mg/kg) with no QA.
Summary omits the sampling season ('Station: Spring', Table 1 caption).
Summary correctly notes the Hg abstract range (0.021-0.10) conflicts with the Table 2 TC value 0.014 mg/kg; consistent with this extraction.
unresolved: Hg range conflict: abstract/text 0.021-0.10 mg/kg vs Table 2 minimum 0.014 mg/kg (TC).
SD values >= mean for several Hg/As cells cannot be reconciled from the printed data.

Pb means 2.42-10.98 mg/kg are roughly two orders of magnitude above typical honey Pb; no LOD, CRM or recovery reported to verify. Flame AAS determination of Hg (and As) at 0.006-0.1 mg/kg without stated cold-vapour/hydride generation is analytically doubtful.
Sampling year and apiary vs market origin not reported.
Non-HMI elements Na, K, Ca not extracted.
